title: 1. Create a Comprehensive Series Bible
use_cases: Use when developing a multi-installment narrative to maintain internal consistency
Implement when mapping out complex magic systems or technological rules
Configure when documenting character arcs and interpersonal relationships for future reference
Use when tracking geographical details and physical settings to prevent plot holes
content:
One of the most crucial tools for preserving continuity is a series bible. This document acts as both your reference guide and your development log. It should include detailed information about your:

- Themes and motifs – recurring ideas or symbols that give your story depth
- Rules of the universe – magic systems, technology, or any unique world-building elements
- Plot points – major events and their implications
- Settings – physical descriptions, timelines, and geographical details
- Characters – appearances, backstories, relationships, and personality traits
- login

Updating your series bible continuously ensures that you have a reliable resource to consult whenever you’re writing or revising a new installment.
